subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: Current code proves the bug path, but the active union_id PR depends on an identity source the reporter says bot/v3/info does not provide, so automation should not choose the permanent Feishu identity contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Prove And Land A Stable Identity Fix
options.body: Resolve or replace the open PR around a verified Feishu identity source, then cover all mention parsing paths and add live multi-bot proof.

options.title: Document A Feishu Limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention behavior conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Defer To A Broader Feishu Multi-Bot Design
options.body: Fold this issue into a larger Feishu multi-bot routing design only if maintainers want to solve mention identity, bot-to-bot visibility, and session scope together.

recommendation.title: Prove And Land A Stable Identity Fix
recommendation.body: Resolve or replace the open PR around a verified Feishu identity source, then cover all mention parsing paths and add live multi-bot proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintenance owner, and the decision is specific to Feishu plugin identity behavior.
